    (∀ᶠ x in atBot, ∀ y ≤ x, p y) ↔ (∀ᶠ x in atBot, p x) :=

    -- If for all x sufficiently small, all y ≤ x satisfy p, then in particular x satisfies p.
    filter_upwards [h x] with y hy
    exact hy le_rfl, fun h => by
    -- If for all x sufficiently small, p x holds, then for all x sufficiently small, all y ≤ x satisfy p.

    filter_upwards [h₁ x] with y hy
    have h₂ : y ∈ atBot := by

      exact mem_atBot.mono (le_of_lt hy) h₁
    exact h₂ y⟩
